functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_access_request(p_id uuid, p_token_hash text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, organization text, contact_name text, job_title text, email text, phone text, approx_users integer, message text, status access_request_status, created_at timestamp with time zone, decided_at timestamp with time zone, expired boolean, account_exists boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select r.id, r.organization, r.contact_name, r.job_title, r.email, r.phone, r.approx_users, r.message,
         r.status, r.created_at, r.decided_at,
         r.review_expires_at < now() as expired,
         exists (select 1 from public.profiles p where p.email = r.email and p.deleted_at is null) as account_exists
  from public.access_requests r
  where r.id = p_id and r.review_token_hash = p_token_hash;
$function$
